name: Yumihara Chizuru
source:
She is the mother of a friend, a female teacher, serious and strict, and is feared by her students. However, as a mother and a teacher, she cares about her children, which is why she is so strict with them.

She is not satisfied with her marital life with her husband and because of that she is lonely, so she engages in sugar mama activities.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/mamakatsutomo.html]official site[/url]]
